---CRITIQUE Revenue Trend Under Thin Operating Runway---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Internally consistent (a strictly positive rank multiplier preserves the signed trend's direction, matching the positive expected sign) and a defensible response to the diagnosed tail-only behavior of the prior downside accumulator, though it is an incremental recombination of already-tested components rather than a new mechanism.

---CRITIQUE Margin Compression at Pretax Trough---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: This is a one-operator variant of the archived "Pretax-Stressed Margin Compression" (same signed cost-share trend, conditioner merely re-normalized from cross-sectional level to own-history rank), which is closer to cosmetic tuning of a previously weak result than a substantively different construction.

---CRITIQUE Tax-Exhausted Cash-Earnings Instability---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Purely combinatorial recycling — the tax-trough conditioner has already been crossed with cogs-share volatility and depreciation volatility (both null), and earnings-volatility-predicts-low-returns is itself a well-known published anomaly, so little incremental economics is added.

---CRITIQUE Tax Capacity per Depreciation---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: The ratio is mechanically unstable (dp in the denominator approaches zero) and, more damagingly, its cross-sectional variation is dominated by asset-lightness rather than "tax capacity," so it conflates the intended profitability signal with an unmodeled capital-intensity confound.

---CRITIQUE Working-Capital-Stressed Gross Inflection---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Effectively a rediscovery of the archived generation-1 "Cash-Scarcity Gross Profit Inflection" — identical winsorized gross-profitability trend with only the liquidity conditioner swapped from che/at to wcap/at (a conditioner already used elsewhere in the archive).

---CRITIQUE Depreciation-Adjusted Earnings Position---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: A single-theme, near-textbook construct (own-history rank of EBITDA/assets) that is a thinly disguised profitability/earnings-level anomaly, offers no cross-theme interaction as required, and is too trivial to merit a test slot.
